hooks.command: input=$(cat); printf '%s' "$input" | grep -q 'git push' || exit 0; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git fetch origin main -q 2>/dev/null || exit 0; git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD 2>/dev/null && exit 0; printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"origin/main is not merged into the current branch. Run `git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main` before pushing (avoids conflicts at PR time). — .claude/settings.json PreToolUse hook"}}'
hooks.statusMessage: Checking origin/main is merged before push...

hooks.command: input=$(cat); printf '%s' "$input" | grep -qi 'git commit' || exit 0; printf '%s' "$input" | grep -qiE 'co-authored-by|generated with' || exit 0; printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Commit messages must not include AI attribution trailers (Co-Authored-By / Generated with ...). Remove them and retry. — .claude/settings.json PreToolUse hook"}}'
hooks.statusMessage: Checking commit message for AI attribution trailers...

hooks.command: p=$(command -v python3 || command -v python); if [ -z "$p" ]; then cat >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; echo '[runtime-lane] no python interpreter on PATH -- command NOT checked' >&2; exit 0; fi; "$p" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.agent-hooks/block_runtime_commands.py"
hooks.statusMessage: Checking the experiment command runs where the registry lives...

hooks.command: p=$(command -v python3 || command -v python); if [ -z "$p" ]; then cat >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; echo '[rules-size] no python interpreter on PATH -- size budget NOT checked' >&2; exit 0; fi; "$p" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.agent-hooks/check_rules_size.py"

s="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.agent-hooks/build-agents.py"; p=$(command -v python3 || command -v python); if [ -z "$p" ] || [ ! -f "$s" ]; then cat >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; echo '[build-agents] interpreter or script unresolved -- generated lanes NOT rebuilt' >&2; exit 0; fi; "$p" "$s" --hook
